data.one_liner: Generate N colors using a set of basic colors, supporting HEX and RGBA.
data.what_it_does: Color palette generator that takes a set of basic colors in HEX or RGBA format and generates an expanded palette of N colors. It supports HTML colors and offers utilities to manipulate color schemes.
use_when: You need to dynamically generate a larger color palette from a base set of colors.
You are working with HEX and RGBA color strings in Dart.
avoid_when: You need complex UI color pickers or complete design systems.
You require platform-specific native color integration.
strengths: Supports both HEX and RGBA color formats.
Simple API for generating expanded color palettes.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic usage examples.
Small ecosystem and niche use case.
